views.name: sales_2020
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    hfsm.product_code AS product_id,
    hfsm.sold_quantity AS sales_quantity,
    SUM(wo.total_amt_usd) AS sales_price
FROM
    hardware_fact_sales_monthly AS hfsm
JOIN
    web_orders AS wo ON hfsm.customer_code = wo.account_id
WHERE
    hfsm.fiscal_year = 2020
GROUP BY
    hfsm.product_code
views.description: Select sales records for the year 2020.

views.name: sales_2021
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    hfsm.product_code AS product_id,
    hfsm.sold_quantity AS sales_quantity,
    wo.total_amt_usd * wo.standard_qty AS sales_price
FROM
    hardware_fact_sales_monthly AS hfsm
JOIN
    web_orders AS wo ON hfsm.customer_code = wo.account_id
WHERE
    hfsm.fiscal_year = 2021
views.description: Select sales records for the year 2021.

views.name: aggregate_top_products
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    hd.division AS division_name,
    hd.product_code AS product_id,
    AVG(hf.sold_quantity) AS average_quantity_sold
FROM
    hardware_dim_product hd
JOIN
    hardware_fact_sales_monthly hf ON hd.product_code = hf.product_code
GROUP BY
    hd.division,
    hd.product_code
ORDER BY
    hd.division,
    hd.product_code
views.description: Calculate the average quantity sold for the top three hardware products within each division.

views.name: orders_by_region
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  T1.region,
  COUNT(T2.id) AS "order_count",
  SUM(T2.total_amt_usd) AS "total_sales_amount"
FROM web_orders AS T2
INNER JOIN hardware_dim_customer AS T1
  ON T2.account_id = T1.customer_code
GROUP BY
  T1.region
views.description: Groups orders by region to calculate sales totals and order counts.

views.name: top_sales_reps_per_region
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    wr.name AS region,
    srs.name AS sales_rep,
    SUM(wo.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales_amount
FROM
    web_region wr
JOIN
    web_sales_reps srs ON wr.id = srs.region_id
JOIN
    web_orders wo ON srs.id = wo.account_id
GROUP BY
    wr.name,
    srs.name
ORDER BY
    total_sales_amount DESC,
    srs.name
views.description: Ranks sales representatives by total sales within each region, including ties.

views.name: faculty_salaries
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  T1.FacNo AS faculty_id,
  T1.FacSalary AS salary
FROM university_faculty AS T1
views.description: Select faculty members and their salaries.

views.name: rank_salaries
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    "FacRank" AS rank,
    AVG("FacSalary") AS average_salary
FROM university_faculty
GROUP BY "FacRank"
views.description: Calculate the average salary for each rank.
